{{Top|leg}}
A '''universal power pack''' was a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] component.It was a generic replacement for the weapon's [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]]. However, because it had to use the appropriate adaptors, energy from the pack was lost in the transfer to the weapon due to the adaptors, resulting in a less powerful blast.
